plain_description.what: One automated run that asks an LLM to write a grading rubric for multiple-choice questions, from 40 training questions of MMLU-Pro, to be plugged into the new (v2) judging recipe.
plain_description.why: The v2 judging pipeline needs a rubric component before its pilot can run; this test produces and checks that component.
plain_description.information: It tells whether the rubric-writing step works mechanically, not whether rubrics help. Result: done; the artefact was produced on the first try and passed its formal checks, but a review found it grades the answer format (a bare letter), not the answer itself, so it was NOT ADOPTED and a second induction was ordered. It makes no claim about rubric value or accuracy.
